purpose: Generated-tested structural review contract; no image execution or scientific acceptance authority

rules.json: Original immutable UTF8 bytes; duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers, unknown fields and boolean ordinals rejected.
rules.plan: Reconstruct every structural field with the unchanged original planner. Canonical packet/gallery SHA256 values are bindings only, not proof of original input provenance.
rules.bundle: A source-plan bundle requires explicit source_id selection. Documents bind SHA256 of the entire original supplied plan bytes.
rules.identity: Exact contract hash, raw plan hash, source and clock, lane and zero-based batch index. Previous hash is null only for batch zero; otherwise SHA256 of immediately preceding own-stream original bytes.
rules.observations: One ordered observation for each scheduled native frame including overlap. Native is the exact full plan frame object. Camera_view is a document-local nonempty view ID, or null only with unknown camera evidence. Equal view strings across documents never establish view correspondence. Gallery context supplies no observations or truth.
rules.local_ids: Nonempty bounded document-local IDs, unique within their own actor/event namespace. Equal strings across documents never imply correspondence.
rules.evidence: Evidence frame arrays are strictly increasing unique integers in the document batch. Visible actors need evidence; every actor evidence frame must cite that actor in its observation. Hidden/unknown actors may have empty evidence.
rules.intervals: Inclusive native intervals lie within the document batch. Evidence lies within interval. Both endpoints may be null only with no evidence and uncertain/unknown support; supported events need evidence. No exact physical timing is inferred.
rules.contacts: Every observed/possible contact observation has a serve/shot/unresolved_contact event citing that evidence frame. Unknown/not_observed never proves physical absence. Repeated mentions remain separate variants.
rules.terminal: Only rally_end may have a nonunknown terminal_basis; rally_end family/side remain unknown. Stopped play, last stroke and shuttle absence remain limitations and never prove exact ending. Observed opening/ending needs a supported serve/rally_end respectively, with observed_terminal for ending. Censoring and unknown boundaries remain explicit.
rules.links: Only immediate-predecessor local IDs may be cited. Supplied evidence is shared overlap present in both definitions. Same-event/supported-actor requires nonempty shared evidence and one-to-one noncontradictory mapping; supported actors must both be visible. Distinct/unresolved may be unsupported claims with empty evidence and explicit uncertainty notes. Missing, unresolved or conflicting evidence is retained as unresolved diagnostics. Links never merge events or actors.
rules.prefix: Only chronological prefixes accepted. Full expected native denominator and all unchanged parsed document variants and raw hashes retained. Private coverage records selected source/lane/raw plan hash, expected/observed/missing native ordinals and per-frame observation counts including zero counts. Unavailable plan accepts zero documents and retains reason and denominator.
rules.notes: Every notes field is explicit text of at most 8192 characters; empty string is permitted.
rules.acceptance: Structural coverage only. Scientific complete_references=0; all four eligibility flags false; scientific_acceptance_changed=false; execution_authorized=false. No classifier scores or scientific acceptance.
